notFound: This task does not exist or was deleted.

progress.title: Generating
progress.note: Generation time depends on the provider; no estimated progress is shown.

reason.user_limit: You have several tasks running; this starts automatically

failed.title: Generation failed
failed.hint: Adjust the description or settings and generate again; this creates a new task.

cancelled.title: Task cancelled
cancelled.hint: Costs incurred were settled and the rest of the reservation was returned.

credits.title: Credits
credits.note: Charged by actual usage. The reservation is the amount confirmed at submission, not a cap; anything beyond it comes from your balance.

exec.title: Execution details
exec.note: Only steps reported by the server are shown.

confirmCancel.title: Cancel this task?
confirmCancel.effect1: Steps that have not started will not run
confirmCancel.effect2: Costs already incurred are settled; the rest of the reservation is returned

confirmDelete.title: Delete this task record?
confirmDelete.effect1: The record is removed from the task list
confirmDelete.effect2: Generated works stay in the library

done.cancelling: Cancellation requested; waiting for the server

review.title: Your decision is needed
review.intro: Preview each clip, then keep it, redo it or upgrade it to 2K.
review.deadlineSoon: About {{hours}} hours left; please decide by {{time}}.
review.expiry: If it expires, the task is cancelled: costs incurred are settled and the rest of the reservation is returned.

quote.title: Quote
quote.note: The server quote at confirmation applies; if the price changes you are asked to confirm again.

review.priceChanged: The price changed. Review the new quote.
review.insufficient: Your credits do not cover the additional cost.

publish.title: Publish to the community?
publish.effect1: Everyone can see this work in the community
publish.effect2: Its generation prompt is shown with it; private references stay private

panelRetry.title: Redraw unfinished panels
panelRetry.body: Finished panels are kept; these panels are generated again and the page is recomposed.
panelRetry.newTask: This creates a new task linked to this one; this task stays as it is.
